target_and_gate.column: one selected BON nighttime column, 45 atmospheric layers; do not generalize beyond the selected call
target_and_gate.state_gate: Before source comparison, prove the upcoming legacy packet and retained GP N2 matched-dry carrier have the same selected-call location/time, 45-layer pressure and temperature profiles, surface temperature/emissivity, water/dry-air geometry, and N2 policy. The GP N2 carrier is the pinned N2=0.7808 run on the matched-legacy-dry input; that does not prove the future legacy capture used identical state.
target_and_gate.packet_gate: Use only the final additive v2 export utility and its terminal successful packet. Validate that the legacy packet reconstructs its own captured native broadband fluxes before any cross-engine interpretation.
target_and_gate.pending: The actual legacy source packet from this new hook is not included here; no numerical comparison results are claimed.

legacy_native.RTE_PLANCK_LEVEL_NATIVE: (16 bands,46 interfaces); packet slot 1 is Fortran level 0/surface, then levels 1..45
legacy_native.RTE_PLANCK_SURFACE_NATIVE: (16 bands); already contains surface emissivity; do not multiply emissivity again
legacy_native.RTE_PLANCK_FRACTIONS: (140 legacy g-points,45 layers); transpose of fracs(layer,gpoint)
legacy_native.RTE_BAND_*_NATIVE: (16 bands,46 interfaces); per-band uflux/dflux/uclfl/dclfl before DELWAVE, broadband accumulation and final flux conversion
legacy_native.orientation_rule: Match layer/interface values by pressure and recorded Fortran level convention, not serialized shape alone.

retained_gp_n2_sidecar.BAND_LIMITS_GPOINT: (2,16,1), inclusive one-based g-point start/end per GP band
retained_gp_n2_sidecar.retained_input: matched-dry 45-layer input; N2 override 0.7808 recorded in the result/sidecar

spectral_comparison.nonmatching_bands: Exclude bands 1-2 and 14-16 from paired spectral conclusions. Legacy edges are 10-350, 350-500, 2250-2380, 2380-2600, 2600-3250; GP edges are 10-250, 250-500, 2250-2390, 2390-2680, 2680-3250 cm-1. Report those bands only engine-native.
spectral_comparison.gpoints: Legacy has 140 g-points and GP has 128. Never match by index, interpolate one engine’s g-points to the other, or compute unweighted g-point means.
spectral_comparison.source_reduction: GP compute_Planck_source constructs g-point source as band Planck value times its interpolated Planck fraction; within-band GP source comparison uses ordered sum over that band’s recorded g-point limits, not a mean. Legacy provides band Planck fields and per-layer fractions; reconstruct its per-g-point source from those fields and follow the pinned legacy recurrence/conversions. Demonstrate units and any DELWAVE/FLUXFAC/WTDIFF roles from source before converting to shared units. No guessed shared weights.

analysis_sequence: 1. Freeze/hash the actual new legacy source packet, capture/terminal receipt, v2 parser/reproducer, executable/source/data/dependency pins and GP N2 matched-dry input/result/sidecar. Verify unchanged pre/post pins.

2. Validate packet dimensions, dtype, finite values, pressure ordering, 140-g-point partition, 16 bands, 45 layers/46 interfaces, fractions, temperatures, emissivities and conversion scalars. Reconstruct RTE_BAND_*_NATIVE broadband fluxes using DELWAVE in original band order and native precision, then FLUXFAC; require match to packet’s ordinary total/clear outputs and captured operational values. Do not multiply by surface emissivity twice.

3. Reproduce/check the exact N2-enabled GP matched-dry result; assert pressure/temperature and surface state equal the legacy source packet. Retain its source arrays and TOTAL_TAU. Do not use the N2-absent sidecar as source oracle.

4. Align by pressure/temperature and exact physical band edges. For bands 3–13 report native legacy per-layer/per-interface Planck fields and fracs-derived g-point source sums, next to the ordered sum of GP per-gpoint source by those bands. Keep native-units columns until source-verified conversions are derived.

5. Compare source profiles separately from opacity. Report legacy actual per-band optical-depth arrays only if the final packet includes them; otherwise do not claim an opacity separation from legacy. GP TOTAL_TAU remains available for GP only. Do not inject legacy band-source data into GP gpoints or vice versa without a justified spectral mapping.

6. Reconstruct each engine’s own band flux/heating with its own recurrence, units and angular transport. Validate reconstructions against same-engine captures before comparing integrated common-band flux profiles. Preserve bands outside 3–13 separately.
7. Describe any remaining residual as a combined difference; this one column cannot establish accuracy, observational agreement, or exact RRTMG/RRTMGP equivalence.
limits: Plan only; no actual new legacy packet comparison was performed.
A matching temperature and physical band edge do not make engine-specific Planck fractions interchangeable.
Same-band summed fluxes can be compared after validating conversion and recurrence, but there is no common correlated-k point identity.
The retained GP sidecar is the GP calculation’s own diagnostic, not independent physical truth.
